<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|304|THE ACTES|CHA. VI.}}</noinclude>Excommunication that S. Paul {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''1. Cor. 5''.}}gaue out against the incestuous and others, had the corporal vexation of Satan incident vnto it.

''4. In thy povver.''] {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Vovv of Chastitie, & the breache thereof.}}''If it displeased God'' (saith S. Augustine) ''to vvithdravv of the money vvhich they had vovved to God, hovv is he angry vvhen chastitie is vovved and is not performed? for to such may be said that vvhich S. Peter said of the money: Thy virginitie remaining did it not remaine to thee, and before thou didst vovv, vvas it not in thine ovvne povver? for, vvhosoeuer haue vovved such things and haue not paied them, let them not thinke to be condemned to corporal deaths, but to euerlasting fire. August. Ser. 10. de diuersis''. And S. Gregorie {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Greg. li. 1. ep. 33''.}}to the same purpose vvriteth thus, ''Ananias had vovved money to God, vvhich aftervvard ouercome vvith diuelish persuasion he vvithdrevv: but vvith vvhat death he vvas punished, thou knovvest. If then he vvere vvorthy of that death, vvho tooke avvay the money that he had giuen to God, consider vvhat great peril in Gods iudgement thou shalt be vvorthy of, vvhich hast vvithdravven, not money, but thy self from almighty God, to vvhom thou hadst vovved thy self vnder the habite or vveede of a Monke''.

''4. Not to men, but.''] To take from the Church or from the Gouernours thereof, things dedicated to their vse and the seruice of God, or to lie vnto Gods Ministers, is so iudged of before God, as if the lie vvere made, and the fraude done to the Holy Ghost him self, vvho is the Churches President and Protector.

''15. His shadovv.''] {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Peters shadovv & intercession.}}Specially they sought to Peter the cheefe of al, vvho not onely by touching, as the other, but by his very shadovv cured al diseases. vvhere vpon S. Augustine saith, If then the shadovv of his body could helpe, hovv much more novv the fulnes of povver? And if then a certaine litle vvind of him passing by did profite them that humbly asked, hovv much more the grace of him novv being permanent & remaining? ''Ser. 29. de Sanctis'', speaking of the miracles done by the Saincts novv reigning in heauen.

{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. VI.}}}}}}

{{c|''By occasion of a murmur in the Church (vvhose number novv is so growen that it can not be numbred) Seuen of them being ordered by the Apostles in the holy order of Deacons: 8 one of them, Steuen, worketh great miracles: and is by such as he confounded in disputation, falsely accused in the Councel, of blasphemie against the Temple and rites thereof.''}} {{dropinitial|A|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial A, a bearded man.png|imgsize=115px|fl={{verse|chapter=6|verse=1}}}}ND in those daies the numbre of disciples increasing, there arose a {{sup|‖}} murmuring of the Greekes against the Hebrues, for that their vvidovves vvere despised in the daily ministerie. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=2}}† And the Tvvelue calling together the multitude of the disciples, said, It is not reason, that vve leaue the vvord of God, and serue tables. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=3}}† Consider therfore brethren, {{sup|‖}} seuen men of you of good testimonie, ful of the holy Ghost and vvisedom, vvhom vve may appoint ouer this busines. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=4}}† But vve vvil be instant in praier and the ministerie of the vvord. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=5}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The election of the 7 first Deacons.}}∷ And the saying vvas liked before al the multitude. And they chose Steuen a man ful of faith and of the holy Ghost, and Philippe, and Próchorus, and Nicánor, and Timon, and Pármenas, and Nicolas a {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''προσήλυτον.''}}∷ stranger of Antioche, {{verse|chapter=6|verse=6}}† These they did set in the presence of the Apostles: and praying {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Order of Deacons given by imposition of hands. See Annot. Act. 13, 3.}}∷ they imposed handes vpon them. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=7}}† And the vvord of God increased, and the number of the disciples vvas multiplied in Hierusalem excedingly: a great multitude also of the {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Now also the Priests and they of greater knowledge & estimation began to beleeue.}}∷ priests obeied the faith.<noinclude>{{rh|||And}}</noinclude>
